_what: The Stim Tin, in the Regulation Nook of Helen Edgar's Faery Yurt: her ask of 2026-10-28, named by her, with photographs of stim toys and a film. tools/make-yurt-stim.py writes it into faery-yurt.html between yurt-stim markers. Each line about how a toy feels is ours, written for her nook; none says what a toy does for anybody.
_photos: Every photograph is a real one off Wikimedia Commons, of a toy and nobody's hands or face, under a licence this site can use, read off its own file page on 2026-10-28, each saying in `real` how it is known to be a photograph, resized and saved without camera data.
intro: My stim tin: things to fidget and stim with, and what each one feels like in the hand.

toys.name: A bit of everything
toys.feel: Stringy, twisty, spiky, soft, and something to watch: a whole board to pick from.
toys.shows: A pastel striped board laid out with fidget toys: a rubbery stringy ball, a twisty tangle, a wand of liquid glitter, a puzzle cube, a spiky ball and a soft brush.
toys.real: Its Commons page carries the camera's record: a Pixel 3a, 7 August 2019.

toys.name: A fidget spinner
toys.feel: Spins and spins, with a hum you can feel in your fingers.
toys.shows: A red fidget spinner with three arms, on a white table.
toys.real: Its Commons page carries the camera's record: an iPhone 6s Plus, 28 May 2017.

toys.name: A fidget cube
toys.feel: A click, a switch, a dial: something different on every side.
toys.shows: A white fidget cube with yellow buttons, a switch and a dial.
toys.real: Its Commons page carries the camera's record: a Redmi Note 8, 9 February 2021.

toys.name: A pop-it
toys.feel: Rows of bubbles to press with a soft pop, then turn it over and pop them all again.
toys.shows: A rainbow pop-it shaped like a whale, lying on a tiled floor.
toys.real: Its Commons page carries the camera's record: a Moto E (4), 25 September 2021.

toys.name: Squishes
toys.feel: Squeeze, and let go slowly, and squeeze again.
toys.shows: Three squeezy foam toys on a dark table: a blue cube, a yellow star and a green ball.
toys.real: Its Commons page carries the camera's record: a Canon EOS 400D, 6 July 2009.

toys.name: A slinky
toys.feel: Pours from one hand to the other with a soft shush.
toys.shows: A rainbow slinky standing in an arch on a stone floor.
toys.real: Its Commons page carries the camera's record: a vivo Y17s, 9 June 2025.

toys.name: A crochet square
toys.feel: Soft wool, with a ball inside to chase about with your thumb.
toys.shows: A soft pale yellow crochet square with blue stitches, made with a ball inside it to push about.
toys.real: Its Commons page carries the camera's record: an iPhone 13 Pro, 4 October 2025.

toys.name: A going-out bag
toys.feel: Quiet for the ears, words on a card, and something for the hands.
toys.shows: A sensory bag laid out on a dark counter: ear defenders, a lanyard, a card of picture symbols and a pink and yellow fidget chain.
toys.real: Its Commons page carries the camera's record: an iPhone 13 Pro Max, 14 August 2022.
